Title: Army Forge URL Source: https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/armyInfo/fk1mkbp8apvltu0z/2/preview Markdown Content: [![Image 1: Home](https://army-forge.opr-cdn.com/app/onepagerules_round_128x128.png)](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/) Dwarf Guilds [Studio](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/studio "Army Forge Studio") [Sign In](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/auth/signin) GF - Dwarf Guilds v3.5.3 ## Intro Dwarves are short humanoids, united under the banner of a conglomerate of mega-companies. Their armies are made up of slow warriors with powerful weaponry, which rely on having a solid long-term plan to make up for their low mobility. The Dwarf Guilds rapidly expanded outwards from their home world, hoping to claim ever more of the galaxy’s resources. These ambitions eventually resulted in them starting a war that they could not win. Desperation led them to activate a machine that would end up destroying much of the Sirius Sector. Now the scattered survivors seek to rebuild with the same ambition of their predecessors. ## About OPR OPR (www.onepagerules.com) is the home of many free games which are designed to be fast to learn and easy to play. This project was made by gamers for gamers and it can only exist thanks to the support of our awesome community. If you want to help us in making more awesome content, you can support us on www.patreon.com/onepagerules Thank you for playing! ## Background Story The Dwarves originated on a mineral rich but inhospitable world. In order to escape the harsh conditions of the surface, their civilization developed underground where conditions were more stable. As their civilization continued to grow, they started to discover and innovate new uses for the ores and resources they uncovered as they dug their cities. Guilds of miners arose to stake claims on these ores, and soon, Guild Lords became the richest and most powerful Dwarves on their planets, holding absolute control of the ore which their society depended on. The Guilds were driven by a demand for constant growth and competition with rival Guilds, causing them to mine ever deeper into their home world’s crust. The Guilds continued until they had stripped their world nearly bare, before turning toward space. They expanded rapidly outwards, their wealth grew as Guilds competed to stake claims over new systems. This rapid expansion only slowed when the Dwarves began to encounter more powerful factions. After some initial tension, the Dwarves struck up an alliance with the Elves. The Elves conceded a number of border worlds to the Dwarves while trade between the factions of Sirius flourished. Noticing the disunity of the Orcs, the Guilds used a Orc raids as a pretext to begin expanding into their territory. After their initial success, the Guilds became more ambitious and began to expand deep into Orc territory. The Orcs united against them and quickly began to turn the tide. The Dwarves became desperate to recover what resources as they retreated, stripping many planets bare. Dwarves became increasingly desperate for resources and sought to create a wormhole that would allow them to rapidly extract resources from distant worlds, even other galaxies. When they activated their machine, something went terribly wrong. The Radiance Cascade tore through much of Sirius in an instant, destroying most of their worlds and killing most of those residing in Guild territory. The survivors were largely miners working on systems at the edge of their space. Following the Cascade, the Guilds moved quickly to evacuate survivors and adapt to a space born life. Most Dwarves now live on mobile mining fleets. These fleets travel through their territory extracting everything they can from a system before abandoning it. The Dwarves have also taken an interest in the Zone, contending that they have exclusive rights of salvage there. Tough(24) | 930pts | 2 GF - Dwarf Guilds v3.5.3 ## Army-Wide Special Rule Sturdy:When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away, they get +1 to defense rolls. ## Special Rules Fortified:When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). Guarded:When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away, they get +1 to defense rolls. Infiltrate:Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3” away from enemy unit. Melee Slayer:When this model charges, its weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher. Mend:Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it. Precision Frenzy:Place one marker on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two markers. For each marker all models with this rule in this unit get +1 to hit rolls until the end of the game. Re-Position Artillery:Once per activation, pick one friendly model within 6" with Artillery, which may immediately move by up to 9". Shred:On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound. Speed Debuff:Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which moves -2" when using Advance actions and -4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply). Sturdy Boost:If all models in this unit have Sturdy, they always get +1 to defense rolls from Sturdy (instead of only when being shot/charged from over 9" away). Surge:On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hits (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules). Swift:This model may ignore the Slow rule. Unpredictable:When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Unpredictable Fighter:When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. ## Aura Special Rules Ignores Cover when Shooting Aura:This model and its unit get Ignores Cover when shooting. Increased Shooting Range Aura:This model and its unit get +6" range when shooting. Infiltrate Aura:This model and its unit get Infiltrate. Regeneration Aura:This model and its unit get Regeneration. Stealth Aura:This model and its unit get Stealth. Sturdy Boost Aura:This model and its unit get Sturdy Boost. Swift Aura:This model and its unit get Swift. Unpredictable Fighter Aura:This model and its unit get Unpredictable Fighter. ## Army Spells **Battle Rune (1):** Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +6" range when shooting once (next time the effect would apply). **Breaking Rune (1):** Pick one enemy model within 24", which takes 1 hit with AP(4). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. **Armor Rune (2):** Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Sturdy Boost once (next time the effect would apply). **Smiting Rune (2):** Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 4 hits with AP(1) and Shred. **Deceleration Rune (3):** Pick up to three enemy units within 18", which moves -2" when using Advance actions and -4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply). **Cleaving Rune (3):** Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 3 hits with Blast(3). 3 GF -
